privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How Trade Lab handles information used for accounts, strategy research and service operation.

sections.title: Information used by the service
sections.body: Account information includes your email address, profile details and sign-in information. If you choose Google sign-in, Google provides the identity information needed to authenticate your account. Research information includes messages, strategy designs, generated code, backtest settings, results and your interactions with those results.

sections.title: Why this information is used
sections.body: This information supports sign-in, saved research history, AI responses, strategy generation, historical backtests and error diagnosis. Service requests may also involve technical records such as request identifiers, timestamps, device or browser information and error details, depending on the deployed infrastructure.

sections.title: AI and service providers
sections.body: Producing AI responses requires processing your prompts and relevant research context through AI services. Authentication, email delivery, hosting and storage may also involve service providers. The provider list, processing locations, retention settings and any use for model training must be verified for the production service before this policy is finalised. Do not include credentials or information you are not authorised to share in a research prompt.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
sections.body: Trade Lab uses session cookies for sign-in and browser storage for preferences such as language and appearance. Unsent research drafts and pending submissions are stored in the current browser tab so that a login or retry can continue your work. Clearing site data can remove these local settings and drafts; it does not by itself delete research already saved to your account.

sections.title: Retention and deletion
sections.body: Saved research supports reopening conversations and reviewing strategy and backtest history. You can delete conversations through the research-history controls. Deleting a conversation is separate from deleting an account or removing operational logs and backups. Retention periods, backup expiry and the account-deletion process remain to be confirmed for the production service.

sections.title: Your choices and requests
sections.body: You can change supported account details and preferences in the workspace. Depending on applicable law, you may be entitled to request access, correction, deletion, a copy of your data, or limits on its processing, and to raise a concern with a relevant authority. The verified contact channel, identity checks, response process and applicable legal basis will be completed before publication.

sections.title: Payments and policy changes
sections.body: Paid subscriptions and credit purchases are not yet enabled. If billing is introduced, this policy will identify the payment providers and the order or billing data involved. Material changes to data handling will be reflected in an updated policy; the date above identifies this draft.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: The scope and conditions of using Trade Lab as a strategy research workspace.

sections.title: What Trade Lab provides
sections.body: Trade Lab helps you discuss trading ideas, develop hypotheses, generate strategy code, test against historical market data and review results. It is research software. It does not hold customer funds, execute trades or provide brokerage services. The initial public offering does not include a live-trading Runner service.

sections.title: Accounts and access
sections.body: Use accurate account information and keep access to your sign-in email secure. You are responsible for activity you authorise through your account. Do not share verification codes, impersonate another person, bypass access restrictions or use another person’s research without permission.

sections.title: Research and AI limitations
sections.body: AI-generated explanations and code can contain errors. Backtests depend on the available historical data, assumptions, fees, market conditions and execution model. Historical or simulated results do not establish future returns. Review the strategy and backtest conditions before each run. Research output is not a recommendation to buy or sell a financial product, and the headline “3 minutes” is not a guaranteed completion time.

sections.title: Your content and generated output
sections.body: You must have permission to submit the material you provide. You retain rights you already hold in that material; operating the service requires processing it to perform your requested research and maintain your account history. Generated output may be similar to output provided to others and may require review for accuracy and third-party rights. Third-party software and market data remain subject to their applicable licences.

sections.title: Acceptable use and availability
sections.body: Do not use the service for unlawful activity, malware, unauthorised access, interference with other users, or attempts to defeat usage limits. Access may be limited to address misuse, security incidents or operational issues. Features may change and the service may be interrupted for maintenance or external provider failures; uninterrupted availability is not promised.

sections.title: Plans, payments and ending use
sections.body: Current plan amounts are previews. Paid subscriptions and credit purchases are not yet available, and no purchase is completed by selecting a preview. Before charging, the service must disclose the actual price, allowance, billing cycle, renewal, cancellation and refund terms. You may stop using the service; account deletion and termination procedures will be confirmed before these terms are finalised.

sections.title: Operator and governing terms
sections.body: The contracting entity, contact information, applicable law, dispute process and any limitations of liability will be completed after the operator and service jurisdictions are confirmed. This draft does not replace rights that cannot be excluded under applicable law.
